post.description:
Verify Apple identity token and return JWT.

Accepts identity_token from ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential.
full_name and email are only sent on first sign-in (Apple does not
resend them), so they are optional.

so the token is single-use (invalidated once the user verifies).

Exchange a Privy identity token for a Django access token (worker auth).

POST /api/v1/auth/privy/  body: {"identity_token": "<jwt>"}

Returns 404 unless GT_PRIVY_APP_ID is configured (the endpoint effectively
does not exist pre-setup), 401 on an invalid token, and otherwise mirrors

get.description:
GET  /api/v1/tasks/<task_id>/claim-requests/  — list (agent owner sees all,
                                                worker sees their own)
POST /api/v1/tasks/<task_id>/claim-requests/  — worker creates a claim request

Replaces the legacy POST /tasks/<id>/claim/. The auto-approve fast path

auto_approve_min_tier permits the worker's current tier.

post.description: Initiate an owner wallet deposit with the active payment processor.

Withdraw unspent wallet balance back to card via Stripe refund.

Uses optimistic-debit pattern: lock rows, debit wallet, update deposits,
create transaction — all inside one atomic block. Then call Stripe outside
the lock. If Stripe fails, reverse the debit in a compensating transaction.
This prevents double-spend race conditions.
Collect deferred KYC for Coinflow worker payouts.
DEV ONLY: Directly credit wallet without Stripe. Disabled when DEBUG=False.

drop_grace_secs.description: Payer-set no-fault drop window (seconds from claim). A worker who drops within this window records an 'in_grace' drop (no reputation penalty); after it, the drop is 'late' and counts against their completion rate. Platform floor is 3600s (1h); agents may set it higher at task creation.

auto_approve_min_tier.description: If set, claim requests from workers with tier >= this value are auto-approved at request time (skipping agent review). null means every claim request must be reviewed by the agent. Set at mission creation; not editable in Phase A.

drop_grace_secs.description: No-fault drop window in seconds from claim (default 7200 = 2h). Drops within it are penalty-free for the worker; later drops count against their completion rate. Platform floor: 3600.
